items.name: narration_hi
items.direction: Narrate this as a high-energy geography countdown Short for BHUGOL, a popular geography fun-facts YouTube channel, in natural spoken Hindi like a top Indian geography explainer channel. The Narrator is SUPER excited and happy, practically bursting with energy: a hyped-up, thrilled YouTube host who loves catching people out with this quiz. Huge smile in the voice the whole way, bright, punchy and lively. Each 'Number five / four / three / two / one' is announced like a game-show reveal with rising hype, number one the biggest. Every 'Not Toronto... it's Ottawa' style line has a teasing beat on the wrong city and a triumphant, grinning hit on the right one. 'But number one is the weirdest' is leaned-in and conspiratorial. Bern's line is a grumpy, put-upon little voice. The last line trails off unfinished, voice staying up, so it loops straight back into the first line. Keep the dramatic pauses on the '...' marks short and punchy, never long. Never slow, flat, calm, sleepy or documentary-serious. VOICE IDENTITY: always the same warm baritone host, same person and same high energy throughout. Numbers and English words (country and city names, capital, number, officially, federal city, Queen Victoria, English, French) are spoken in English, naturally, the way Indian creators mix them. Numbers are always read in English, clearly. Pronounce Canberra as CAN-bruh, Brasília as bra-ZEEL-ya, Abuja as ah-BOO-jah, Abu Dhabi as AH-boo DAH-bee, Bern as BURN, Zurich as ZOOR-ik, U A E as the letters U-A-E.
lines: Five capitals जो लगभग सब गलत बताते हैं।
Number five: Canada. Toronto नहीं... Ottawa है।
Queen Victoria ने eighteen fifty-seven में चुना, English और French Canada के बीच में।
Number four: Australia. Sydney नहीं... Canberra है।
Sydney और Melbourne दोनों को चाहिए था... तो बीच में नया शहर बना दिया।
और अगले देश ने ये और भी तेज़ किया।
Number three: Brazil. Rio नहीं... Brasília है।
बिल्कुल वीराने में बना, करीब four साल में, nineteen sixty से capital.
Number two: Nigeria. Lagos नहीं... Abuja है।
देश के बीच में नया शहर, nineteen ninety-one से capital.
लेकिन number one सबसे अजीब है।
Number one: Switzerland. Zurich? Geneva? नहीं... Bern.
लेकिन... officially, Switzerland की कोई capital ही नहीं है!
Bern: सारा काम मैं करता हूं... और मैं official भी नहीं!
अब जाकर किसी को बताओ वो...
